breakdown.description: The inward hole pressure is reversed to an outward traction by changing the sign relative to the solid normal
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly defined an inward pressure as `t = +p*n` (where `n` is the outward normal), which actually models an outward pressure. The ground truth corrects this to `t = -p*n`. The agent's generated specification repeated the error from the incomplete prompt, stating `implemented as traction t = +p*n where n is the outward normal of the solid domain`, thus failing to resolve the inconsistency.
